caseName: Ruckelshaus v. Union Carbide Agricultural Products Co.
caseNameFull: Ruckelshaus, Administrator, United States Environmental Protection Agency v. Union Carbide Agricultural Products Co.

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. S. D. N. Y. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of Ruckelshaus v. Monsanto Co., 467 U. S. 986 (1984).

Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
